synth.notes:
Ring+beam A1/A2 move -/+6 carrying on-beam blocks via push chain; cancelled if ring or any block leaves the colour-4 field (bbox above the all-2/3 bar row).
A4/A3 beam w +/-6 (1..field right edge); next/collected block at tip-4 hooks and drags on-beam blocks, else extend pushes swept next/collected blocks; blocked group -> beam changes alone.
Tags: hooked next with all other on-beam collected -> collected (next = first todo in legend order); no hook & collected off beam -> reverts. Legend swatch centre 2x2 = 0 while collected. Clicks are full no-ops.
Render: erase old objects to bg (field 4, rail at ring.x+2..3 rows top+2..bot-2 period-6 2,2,3,3,3,3, else 5), draw ring, dashed beam, blocks by layer.
HUD bar: rightmost 2->3 per 3 non-click actions, (n-1)//3; phase n hidden, continuity-gated on frame, fallback 3*bars+1 (unconfirmed off-sequence).
